annotations.title: One parcel with rail and substation access

description:
One land parcel: area, use, built coverage where measured, buildings, a
    constraints summary (counts by kind, never "clear"), the nearest rail station
    and nearest primary substation with headroom, and the owner class. Give a
    `uprn`, or `lat` and `lng` for a point. Use it to size up a site's grid and
    rail access.

    Substation headroom is the network operator's published heat-map figure; it is
    NOT a connection offer. Owner is an owner class only; a company name and number
    appear only for companies and overseas entities, never a person's name. Do NOT
    use it to value or appraise the site. A point with no parcel found returns covered=false.
    Free.

    UK only. Exactly one record; cut to 8 KB. Costs the /sourcing/parcel price, charged only
    when a parcel is returned; covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: land_parcel
